purpose: Says what a catalogue place is and where it is, for a list of same-named places.
namedChanges: The imports: the catalogue client is the unit `geo-catalogue`.

`tail` is replaced by `position` (name rule). GilbApp told two identical rows apart by the tail of the row's catalogue address ("entry osm-r-2775550"): an id drawn as text. A row still identical to others now carries `{ n, of }` and the line ends "1 of 2 with this name".

A container that was not read says so (F12). GilbApp drew the kind alone for `unavailable`, which cannot be told from a place with no container: now "where: not read"; and after a partial chain "and further up: not read".
The module headers and the comments that named hosts, a cycle or an agent are reworded with the same facts. No other code changed.
